description: This file implements cryptographic decryption functions for various algorithms in the ANSC (Advanced Networking Service Container) framework. It provides a general decrypt function that dispatches to specific decryption routines such as DES, 3DES, RC4, RC2, AES, and others, many of which are conditionally compiled based on provided macros. The functions handle buffer operations and utilize cryptographic libraries or custom implementations to perform decryption. The file also includes licensing information and references to external cryptographic libraries like OpenSSL and possibly others.

methods.name: ULONG AnscCryptoDecrypt(ULONG algorithm,PVOID cipher,ULONG size,PVOID plain,PANSC_CRYPTO_KEY key,PANSC_CRYPTO_IV iv)
methods.description: Performs cryptographic decryption based on the specified algorithm, dispatching to relevant decryption routines.

methods.name: ULONG AnscCryptoDesIv64Decrypt(PVOID cipher,ULONG size,PVOID plain,PANSC_CRYPTO_KEY key,PANSC_CRYPTO_IV iv)
methods.description: Decrypts data using DES with a 64-bit Initialization Vector (IV) in CBC mode.

methods.name: ULONG AnscCryptoDesDecrypt(PVOID cipher,ULONG size,PVOID plain,PANSC_CRYPTO_KEY key,PANSC_CRYPTO_IV iv)
methods.description: Performs DES decryption in CBC or ECB mode, depending on the presence of IV.

methods.name: ULONG AnscCryptoTripleDesDecrypt(PVOID cipher,ULONG size,PVOID plain,PANSC_CRYPTO_KEY key,PANSC_CRYPTO_IV iv)
methods.description: Decrypts data using Triple DES in CBC mode with three key schedules.
